item.title: DEA warns meth surge is hitting Treasure Coast as cocaine prices rise
item.description: Federal agents in Palm Beach County seized about 54 kilos of crystal meth in just two days, part of what they call an unprecedented surge in methamphetamine fueled by the rising cost of cocaine. One DEA agent said the surge is beginning to spread to the Treasure Coast.

item.title: Port St. Lucie teen to serve as flag bearer at FIFA World Cup finals
item.description: Enrique Rosario Liz, a Port St. Lucie teenager named Southeast Region Youth of the Year for the Boys & Girls Clubs of America, will serve as one of 12 club members selected to be an official Coca-Cola flag bearer at the FIFA World Cup finals on July 19.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with 105-step climb to panoramic views
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, has guided ships along Florida's Atlantic coast for more than 165 years. The 105-step climb to the top rewards visitors with panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, Jupiter Inlet, and the Loxahatchee and Indian rivers.

item.title: Karolina Muchova defeats Coco Gauff in dramatic Wimbledon semifinal tiebreaker
item.description: Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's Wimbledon run with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) victory Thursday that concluded with a drama-filled tiebreaker, becoming the fourth Czech woman in six years to reach the grass-court Grand Slam final.
